title: Reduction encoding map
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols, natural numbers $d,c$, a deterministic Turing machine $V$ over Booleans, and natural numbers $CV,cV$, define the reduction map on a Boolean list $x$ to be the Boolean-list encoding of the quantified Boolean formula associated to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
$V$ is a deterministic Turing machine over Booleans
caveat: The encoding of quantified Boolean formulas is not defined in the supplied statement.
